title: Artemis cobblemon VG sounds pack
description: Make your cobblemon sound more like the games!
body:
This pack changes a bunch of sounds from cobblemon into ones from the games (mainly gen 4).
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/p1N1b-r8KPo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This was something I made in my spare time so its not perfect as I am self taught.

Updates will be infrequent as I will just update it whenever I work on it, so feel free to take this and update it yourself, just make sure to credit me for the base pack.

All sounds are owned and made by Nintendo, Creatures inc and Gamefreak. I only extracted these sounds for this pack.
